judgments.rationale: The source sets out disjunctive disqualification criteria connected by 'or' in clause (4) ('...service; or (5)...'), meaning that meeting any single condition disqualifies a person from being deemed qualified. The proposed revision alters this logic to require that all conditions be met ('unless all of the following are true... and (5)'), which contradicts the statute.

The source explicitly directs that the designated official 'shall deem any person qualified...'. Populating the action and action_quote fields with 'deem' accurately captures the governing operative action from the text.
